measurements.name: Azores Current
measurements.range_interpretation: Approximate source-reported seasonal core value; no width uncertainty interval supplied.
measurements.geographic_scope: Western WOA-Box section at 19.5 W. A regional cross-current model core extent, with no paired edge coordinates extracted.
measurements.section_orientation: Meridional western WOA-Box section; no exact flow-normal correction inferred.
measurements.layer: Depth-varying inverse-model section. Source reports maximum core depth about 790 m in spring and 1100 m in autumn; these are source-reported vertical context, not fixed depth layers at which these widths were measured.
measurements.time_convention: WOA09 mixed historical climatologies in a regional inverse model; source quarter WOA09 spring climatology (April-June). Not an individual occupation or dated current footprint.
measurements.boundary_rule: Author defines the core using velocities greater than 2 cm/s. No full-current envelope or universal half-peak threshold inferred.
measurements.source_citation: Carracedo, Gilcoto, Mercier and Perez (2014), Seasonal dynamics in the Azores-Gibraltar Strait region: A climatologically-based study, Progress in Oceanography 122, 116-130, doi:10.1016/j.pocean.2013.12.005.
measurements.source_locator: Section 3.1.1.1, printed page 122 / PDF page 7; methods section 2.1, printed page 118 / PDF page 3.
measurements.extraction_method: Author-reported values transcribed from original prose; no contour digitization or model reproduction.
remaining_gates: Recover original model fields and paired boundaries before geometry or scientific reproduction.
Width error and whole-current dimensions remain unknown.
measurements.calendar_source_locator: World Ocean Atlas 2009 Volume 1, Introduction, printed page 1 / PDF page 13

original_regional_context.display_aria_label: WOA09 spring climatology (April-June): about 240 km regional model core span; width error unknown.
original_regional_context.display_caption: WOA09 spring climatology (April-June) · about 240 km in the regional inverse-model core at 19.5 W. Model-climatological seasonal extremes are about 240–400 km; whole-current annual physical range and width uncertainty remain unknown.
original_regional_context.display_method_note: Source criterion: velocities greater than 2 cm/s. WOA09 input grid is 1 degree; finer integration is not improved observational resolution. Historical climatologies have mixed support. Depth varies; no fixed-layer width, monthly interpolation or mapped band inferred.

season_convention.basis: WOA09 quarter definitions, not meteorological month windows
season_convention.source_locator: World Ocean Atlas 2009 Volume 1, Introduction, printed page 1 / PDF page 13
season_convention.source_access: Original Introduction text read and page visually inspected.
